text:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE fired — service=integration/inference-gateway-prod region=eu-west1 metric=5xx_rate value=0.12 window=3m threshold=0.05 escalation_policy=PD-critical

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-789012 triggered -> escalation: Maya (primary on-call). Incident URL: https://pagerduty.company/PD-789012 :rotating_light:

Maya: acked. jumping in. any known deploys?

Sam: no deploys in last 2h from deploy-bot. saw a small config change to upstream-proxy yesterday.

Arjun: I’m looking at ingress logs now. preliminary: connection resets + 502s clustered around a subset of edge nodes (eu-west1-a/b).

Priya: grafana -> https://grafana.company/d/abc/inference-gateway?orgId=1 shows 5xx spike precisely 09:12 -> 09:18. latency also up ~300ms.

Maya: customers reporting longer failures on streaming endpoints — getting user complaints via support. tagging customer-impact.

Arjun: running quick health curl against one of the failing proxies:
```
for node in $(cat bad_nodes.txt); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://$node/health || echo "fail $node"; done
```
Nodes 12/24 returned 502 or connection reset.

Priya: I’m going to route traffic away from the bad AZ for the canary slice. enabling routing override for eu-west1-a.

Maya: do it. Also enable canary fallback to model-variant v1-quant (lower resource) if routing flip doesn’t drop errors.

incident-bot: NOTE: PD escalation window configured to escalate after 3m unacked -> next escalation timer 09:15:00.

Arjun: starting a rolling restart of the edge-proxy pods in eu-west1-a. command:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy --selector=zone=eu-west1-a
```
Should be graceful — will monitor 5xx.

Sam: I’ll throttle non-critical background jobs and pause long-running bulk requests to ease pressure.

Maya: update: ack timeout hit but PD failed to auto-escalate to secondary — can someone check PD escalation chain? pagerduty-bot shows scheduled escalation but no notification.

Priya: Confirmed — PD rule 'windowed-escalation' has an override for holidays that accidentally matched our team schedule. I’m toggling override off.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation triggered -> escalating to Arjun (secondary). Notifying via SMS and Slack.

Arjun: got it. after restart some pods came back healthy. 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 4.5% in 5m. still seeing intermittent 502s.

Maya: customer-impact: high for streaming (partial) — opened a short status note for affected customers, pinging CS.

Sam: KV cache warmup looked cold after restarts. priming cache for hot prefixes now.

Arjun: rolling restart finished. verifying metrics:
- 5xx rate now 1.2% (baseline ~0.6%)
- p95 latency back within SLOs
- failed pod count zero

Priya: removing routing override, traffic back to normal distribution.

Maya: great. I'm going to suppress noisy alert rule for 10m to avoid autopager thrash while we monitor.

incident-bot: action logged: suppress-alert rule=inference-gateway-5xx duration=10m by Maya

Maya: summary for postmortem: probable root cause = transient edge-proxy crashloop related to upstream keepalive exhaustion after config drift. PD escalation window mis-match delayed secondary notification for ~2m. mitigations: restart proxies, route around bad AZ, prime KV cache, fix PD policy override, postmortem to follow.

Arjun: +1. will collect logs and attach error traces to the incident.

Priya: deploying PD policy fix now.

pagerduty-bot: PD-789012 status -> acknowledged by Maya, assigned to Arjun.

Maya: last check shows 5xx stabilized <1%. marking incident as resolved monitor-only for 30m. will open follow-up ticket for PD policy and config drift guardrails. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident PD-789012 closed by Maya at 09:26 UTC. Resolution note: restarts + routing + config override removal.

Sam: thanks all — good coordination.

Maya: filing a short blameless postmortem and action items. adding owners: Arjun (root cause), Priya (routing/PD policy), Sam (cache priming), Maya (postmortem).

end of thread
